questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: Frostleaf spends more cash each month on yoga equipment than it collects. Which statement about its finances is accurate?

options.text: It has no cash risk while it still has a bank balance
options.misconception: Spending above receipts depletes the balance over time

options.text: Its runway is unlimited as long as customers exist
options.misconception: Runway depends on cash and burn, not customers alone

options.text: It has negative cash flow and a finite runway unless funding changes

questions.explanation: When cash outflows exceed inflows, the firm has negative cash flow and its runway, the time until cash runs out, is finite unless it raises funding or reaches profitability. A positive balance or customer base does not remove that constraint.
questions.hint: Spending more than you collect shortens runway.

questions.stem: Glenmarket holds $100,000 in cash and burns $20,000 per month developing bike accessories. About how many months of runway does it have?
questions.explanation: Runway is cash on hand divided by monthly net burn: $100,000 divided by $20,000 per month gives about 5 months. If burn rises or new funding arrives, the actual runway will differ from this estimate.
questions.hint: Divide cash on hand by the monthly burn rate.
